paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Ablation studies on n-best candidates generations (Beam search and Sampling search) on valid set of WMT15 De-En.

annotations.annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores across different models. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL) using a linear scale, ranging from 2.5 to 12.5 with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis represents BLEU scores, also on a linear scale, with values ranging from 24 to 31 and tick labels at intervals of 1. The plot features three lines: a blue dashed line with circle markers represents "Inconsistency-CE," starting at 24 BLEU at an AL of 2.5 and ending at approximately 30.5 BLEU at an AL of 12.5. An orange dashed line with triangle markers represents "Consistency-Bi +sampling," beginning at around 28 BLEU at an AL of 2.5 and reaching approximately 30 BLEU at an AL of 12, showing a steady increase. The green dashed line with square markers represents "Consistency-Bi +beam", starting at 27.5 BLEU at an AL of 2.5 and ending at 31 BLEU at an AL of 12.5, showing consistent improvement as AL increases. The green line and orange line intersect at an x-value of 5. A legend is available on the bottom right of the plot to infer different lines by their styles.
